title: Workflows, stages, transitions, policies and migration
summary: Canonical owner for workflow configuration, type bindings and transition-policy configuration. Board columns map these stages but do not define workflows. Review requests and votes belong to issue collaboration.

cases.title: Read workflows
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open or request the project's workflows.
expected: Accessible retained configuration is returned with stable identities and cursor state.

cases.title: Page workflows
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Request the next cursor page of workflows.
expected: The next bounded page appends to the corresponding list.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-WFL-0091.

cases.title: Select a different workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Select another workflow in settings.
expected: Its stages and transitions replace the previous selection.

cases.title: Select a type's bindings
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose another issue type.
expected: The selected type's allowed and default workflow bindings load.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-WFL-0007.

cases.title: Create a workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a new workflow name.
expected: An active workflow is created without moving existing issues.

cases.title: Rename a workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a new name for an existing workflow.
expected: The stable workflow identity retains its issues and receives the new name.

cases.title: Retire an eligible workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire a workflow with no creation-default binding.
expected: New-work bindings close while existing identities are retained.

cases.title: Restore a retained workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Clear retirement on a retained workflow and save valid configuration.
expected: The workflow becomes active; bindings still require explicit eligible settings.
notes: The service permits clearing retirement, but the current web editor disables Edit workflow when the workflow is retired. Web restoration is not claimed.

cases.title: Create a named custom stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a new stage in the selected active workflow.
expected: The stage receives a stable project/workflow-scoped identity.

cases.title: Create an Arabic-named stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save an Arabic stage name.
expected: The exact Unicode name is retained and displayed.

cases.title: Rename a stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a changed stage name.
expected: Existing issues keep stage identity while its display name changes.

cases.title: Create a todo category stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose todo while creating a new stage.
expected: The stage uses that base category for completion and reporting semantics.

cases.title: Create a in_progress category stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose in_progress while creating a new stage.
expected: The stage uses that base category for completion and reporting semantics.

cases.title: Create a review category stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose review while creating a new stage.
expected: The stage uses that base category for completion and reporting semantics.

cases.title: Create a done category stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose done while creating a new stage.
expected: The stage uses that base category for completion and reporting semantics.

cases.title: Reorder a stage by precise position
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save another positive integer stage position.
expected: Stage ordering retains exact integer precision.

cases.title: Set the initial stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Mark an open To do stage as initial.
expected: It becomes the workflow's initial stage and the old designation clears.

cases.title: Open stage intake
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable Accepts entries for an eligible stage.
expected: Normal eligible transitions can enter the stage.

cases.title: Close stage intake
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Disable Accepts entries while preserving a valid workflow.
expected: Existing issues remain in the stage; new entries stop.

cases.title: Retire a closed unused stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire a closed stage after references are removed.
expected: Retained stage identity becomes retired and stays closed.

cases.title: Restore a retained stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Clear retirement on a stage in an active workflow with safe coverage.
expected: The stage is active again; its explicit intake flag controls entries.

cases.title: Create a directed transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a source-to-destination stage edge in one workflow.
expected: The directed move is retained for eligibility checks.

cases.title: Require member transition permission
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set the move's permission to member.
expected: The move exposes and enforces the selected actor permission.

cases.title: Require administrator transition permission
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set the move's permission to project_admin.
expected: The move exposes and enforces the selected actor permission.

cases.title: Clear an extra transition permission
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Clear the configured required permission.
expected: The move returns to ordinary project-write authorization requirements.

cases.title: Retire a transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire an edge while preserving required completion paths.
expected: The directed move is no longer eligible.

cases.title: Restore a transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Clear retirement on a valid retained edge.
expected: The directed move becomes available under its current guards.

cases.title: Allow a workflow for an issue type
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save an eligible type-to-workflow binding with intake open.
expected: The type may use that workflow for new work.

cases.title: Change a type's creation-default workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose another eligible binding as default.
expected: Future creation uses the new default; existing issues are not migrated.

cases.title: Close a nondefault binding intake
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Disable new-work intake on a nondefault binding.
expected: Existing issues retain their workflow while new issues cannot choose that binding.

cases.title: Select workflow migration targets
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose a destination workflow in the migration editor.
expected: Its stage choices load and paginate independently.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-WFL-0003, UC-WFL-0092.

cases.title: Migrate a same-category issue batch
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Migrate 1–100 issues from a closed source into an eligible same-category target.
expected: The batch commits atomically and reports moved/remaining counts.

cases.title: Continue a remaining migration
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Submit a new migration operation for remaining source work.
expected: Another bounded batch moves without duplicating the previous operation.

cases.title: Require assignee for a transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable the assignee system-field requirement.
expected: The saved transition policy includes that field and movement validates its presence.

cases.title: Require due date for a transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable the due_date system-field requirement.
expected: The saved transition policy includes that field and movement validates its presence.

cases.title: Require description for a transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable the description system-field requirement.
expected: The saved transition policy includes that field and movement validates its presence.

cases.title: Require a custom field for a transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Select an active project custom field as a required value.
expected: The saved policy retains its field ID and movement checks its value.

cases.title: Remove a transition field requirement
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Deselect one requirement and save.
expected: That requirement is absent without removing unrelated policy settings.

cases.title: Require member approvals
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set a positive approval count and member reviewer role.
expected: The policy requires that number of eligible member approvals.

cases.title: Require administrator approvals
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set a positive approval count and project administrator reviewer role.
expected: The policy restricts qualifying approvals to eligible administrators.

cases.title: Exclude the issue reporter from approval
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable reporter exclusion.
expected: The reporter cannot supply a qualifying approval under the policy.

cases.title: Disable required approval
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set required approval count to zero and save.
expected: The editor sends a null reviewer role and the saved policy no longer requires approvals.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-WFL-0095.

cases.title: Reject nonadministrator workflow configuration
preconditions: Actor has project write access but no configuration authority.
steps: Attempt any workflow configuration mutation.
expected: Server project-configuration authority blocks the write.

cases.title: Reject blank workflow name
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save an empty or whitespace-only workflow name.
expected: Validation requires a nonblank bounded name.

cases.title: Reject oversized workflow name
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a workflow name longer than 100 Unicode characters.
expected: Validation rejects the name.

cases.title: Reject blank stage name
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save an empty stage name.
expected: Validation requires a nonblank bounded name.

cases.title: Reject oversized stage name
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a stage name longer than 60 Unicode characters.
expected: Validation rejects the name.

cases.title: Reject nonpositive stage position
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save position zero or a negative position.
expected: Validation refuses an invalid position.

cases.title: Reject changing an existing stage category
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Change a retained stage's base category.
expected: A new stage must be created instead; retained identity is not rewritten.

cases.title: Reject initial stage outside To do
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Mark a non-To-do stage initial.
expected: Validation requires an open To do initial stage.

cases.title: Reject a closed initial stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Close intake while retaining the initial designation.
expected: Validation rejects the closed initial stage.

cases.title: Reject retirement while stage intake is open
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire a stage whose current intake is open.
expected: Close intake before retirement is required.

cases.title: Reject retirement of an occupied stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire a closed stage that still contains issues.
expected: Migration is required before retirement.

cases.title: Reject retirement of a rule-referenced stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire a stage still referenced by assignment rules.
expected: Rules must be remapped before retirement.

cases.title: Reject a self transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Use the same source and destination stage.
expected: Validation refuses a self transition.

cases.title: Reject a cross-workflow transition
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Use stages from different workflows.
expected: Both endpoints must belong to the selected workflow.
notes: Native surface correction: Both transition endpoint selectors enumerate only the selected workflow stages; a cross-workflow raw endpoint is not selectable.

cases.title: Reject rewriting transition endpoints
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Change endpoints on an existing transition ID.
expected: The existing transition identity retains its original endpoints.

cases.title: Preserve a completion path
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Remove the last path from retained work to a Done stage.
expected: The configuration transaction is rejected.

cases.title: Preserve an open initial stage for an in-use workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Remove the workflow's only eligible initial stage.
expected: In-use workflow validation rejects the unsafe state.

cases.title: Reject a default binding without intake
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a creation-default binding with acceptsNew false.
expected: Default bindings must accept new issues.

cases.title: Reject closing the current default binding
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Remove the current creation default before installing a replacement.
expected: An eligible replacement must become default first.

cases.title: Reject enabling a retired type binding
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Open intake for a retired issue type.
expected: Only active types can accept new issues.

cases.title: Reject enabling a retired workflow binding
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Open intake for a retired workflow.
expected: Only active workflows can accept new issues.

cases.title: Require default-board stage coverage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable a workflow whose open or occupied stages are not mapped to the default board.
expected: The workflow cannot accept work until coverage is valid.

cases.title: Reject retirement of a creation-default workflow
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retire a workflow still used by any creation-default binding.
expected: Replace those defaults before retirement.

cases.title: Reject migration from open intake
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Migrate issues before closing source-stage intake.
expected: Validation requires closed source intake.
notes: Native surface correction: The migration source selector enumerates closed stages only; an open source ID is not a native option.

cases.title: Reject migration to the same stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose the source stage as target.
expected: Validation requires different stages.
notes: Native surface correction: Migration targets enumerate open active stages, while the selected source is closed; the source cannot be submitted as its own target.

cases.title: Reject cross-category migration
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose a destination with a different completion category.
expected: Normal complete/reopen transitions are required before representation migration.

cases.title: Reject migration into retired target
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose a retired target stage or workflow.
expected: Target must be open and active.
notes: Native surface correction: Migration target options exclude retired stages; the raw retired target rejection is a service boundary.

cases.title: Reject incompatible type migration
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Migrate source work whose types do not permit the target workflow.
expected: Every retained type must permit the target before migration.

cases.title: Reject an oversized migration batch
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Request more than 100 issue moves in one migration.
expected: Validation rejects the batch size.

cases.title: Reject an empty migration batch size
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Request a migration limit of zero.
expected: Validation requires at least one issue per batch limit.

cases.title: Reject duplicate field requirements
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Submit repeated system/custom-field IDs in a transition policy.
expected: Policy normalization rejects duplicate requirements.
notes: Native surface correction: Native checkbox and multi-select state contains unique field identities; it cannot construct a duplicate-ID policy.

cases.title: Reject foreign-project required fields
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Require a custom field outside the project.
expected: Only scoped active project fields may be required.
notes: Native surface correction: The required-field picker reads only scoped project definitions; it has no input for an arbitrary foreign UUID.

cases.title: Reject retired required fields
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Require a retired custom field.
expected: The policy rejects retired field IDs.
notes: Native surface correction: The native required-field picker filters out retired definitions; a retired UUID cannot be selected as a new requirement.

cases.title: Reject excessive approval count
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set more than 100 required approvals.
expected: Policy validation rejects the count.

cases.title: Reject negative approval count
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Set a negative required approval count.
expected: Policy validation rejects the count.

cases.title: Reject approval role/count mismatch
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Submit zero approvals with a role, or a positive count without a role.
expected: Role and count must form a valid policy.
notes: Native surface correction: The native policy command sets approverRole=null when count=0 and supplies the selected role for positive counts; incompatible raw combinations are service boundaries.

cases.title: Freeze an uncertain workflow save
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retry after the server accepts a write but its response is lost.
expected: The exact pending input and retry reference are reused while the form is frozen.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-WFL-0096.

cases.title: Review a configuration revision conflict
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Review current configuration after a stale settings write.
expected: The draft remains but cannot save until current configuration has been explicitly reviewed.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-WFL-0097.

cases.title: Protect a dirty workflow editor during navigation
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Attempt to leave after editing workflow settings.
expected: The dirty-leave confirmation can retain the current editor instead of discarding it.

cases.title: Recreate project-scoped workflow editing context
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Navigate settings to another project using browser history.
expected: The editor targets only the destination project and respects its access guards.

cases.title: Retain exact large stage positions
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Edit a position larger than JavaScript's exact-number range.
expected: The string/BigInt editing path preserves precise integer position.

cases.title: Read a transition policy
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator with an accessible workflow transition.
steps: Read the requirements and approval policy for a selected workflow transition.
expected: The current required system/custom fields, approval count and role, reporter exclusion, and configuration/workflow revisions are returned.

cases.title: Read another workflow cursor page
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Request a bounded workflow page and its next cursor.
expected: The later workflow identities are returned without overlapping the first page.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0002.

cases.title: Read another workflow-stage cursor page
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Request a bounded stage page and its next cursor within one workflow.
expected: The later stage identities and precise order are returned without overlapping the first page.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0004.

cases.title: Read another transition cursor page
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Request a bounded transition page and its next cursor within one workflow.
expected: The later directed transition identities are returned without overlapping the first page.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0006.

cases.title: Read another type-binding cursor page
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Request a bounded binding page and its next cursor for one type.
expected: The later type/workflow bindings are returned without overlapping the first page.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0008.

cases.title: Disable transition approvals through service
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save approvalsRequired zero with approverRole null while retaining valid unrelated policy requirements.
expected: The saved/read policy requires no approvals and retains its unrelated requirements.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0048.

cases.title: Replay an accepted workflow configuration command
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Repeat the same accepted workflow body and retry reference.
expected: The original result/event receipt is confirmed once without advancing configuration again.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0085.

cases.title: Reject stale workflow configuration revision
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Submit workflow configuration against a superseded project configuration revision.
expected: Conflict preserves the accepted workflow and returns current revision information for a new operation.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-WFL-0086.
